name: What is involved in converting a garage into a home office?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in converting a garage into a home office?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting a garage into a home office is a significant transformation that integrates the new space seamlessly with your existing home. The process typically includes structural modifications, insulation upgrades, HVAC integration, electrical work, plumbing if needed, and high-quality interior finishes tailored to your professional needs. AKN Design Group manages this entire process, from initial design and permit coordination to the final touches, ensuring a cohesive and functional workspace without the homeowner having to manage multiple vendors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage-to-home office conversions involve structural changes, insulation, HVAC, electrical work, and interior finishes to create a cohesive and functional workspace. AKN Design Group manages the entire design-build process.
